narr: Heavy rain produced some marginal flash flooding in Miami County Kansas and nearby Bates County Missouri.
ev: MODOT reported that HWY 18 was closed due to flooding.
Several spots along HWY A and B east and west of Rich Hill were flooded due to heavy rain.
